Commentary: Pakistan Squad: Abdullah Shafique, Imam-ul-Haq, Shan Masood, Babar Azam(c), Saud Shakeel, Mohammad Rizwan(w), Salman Agha, Ali Usman, Khurram Shahzad, Mohammad Ali, Mohammad Abbas, Sajid Khan, Ghazi Ghori, Aamer Jamal, Azan Awais, Ubaid Shah, Abdullah Fazal, Awais Zafar

Squads:
Khurram Shahzad to Jordan Cox, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Khurram Shahzad to Jordan Cox, out Caught by (sub)Salman Agha!! Wow! Straight into the flying Salman's right hand. This is a superb catch from a super sub! He flew to his right, plucked it out of thin air and then sat down and just sported a smile till he was mobbed by his mates. Babar near him couldn't believe it either. That was a fuller length delivery, drew the batter into a drive and the edge came. That was a seam up delivery, landed on the seam and nipped enough to take the edge. The ball I guess had gone beyond him but he snatched it out of thin air. Jordan Cox c (sub)Salman Agha b Khurram Shahzad 55(105) [4s-7]

Khurram Shahzad to Gus Atkinson, FOUR, he can play! Looks to attack the sticks, angled in, Gus Atkinson got the bat down and whipped it behind square for a four. Gus Atkinson is off the mark

Khurram Shahzad to Gus Atkinson, 3 runs, short of length delivery, outside off, Gus Atkinson short arm jabs the ball wide of the bowler and mid-on for a triple. That was stabbed down and the man at mid-on mopped it up

Khurram Shahzad to Jamie Smith, FOUR, a wicket and 11 runs off the over. Poor delivery on the pads, Jamie Smith is happy as a clam to accept it. Whips the ball away uppishly and wide of mid-wicket for a four. Smith will continue batting like this. That was a buffet ball
Only the second fifty by Jamie Smith in his last 10 Test innings.

Mohammad Ali to Gus Atkinson, no run, Gus Atkinson has a Test ton at this venue! So, Pakistan can't afford to relax. That was a length delivery, outside off, stabbed down to cover
